# Pull Request

## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Type

- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Test
- [ ] Refactor
- [ ] Security
- [ ] Performance

## Validation

- [ ] Frontend format, lint, tests, coverage, and build pass.
- [ ] Backend lint, tests, and compile check pass.
- [ ] Manual review completed for affected screens or endpoints.
- [ ] No secrets, JWTs, passwords, or private data are committed.

## Screenshots

Add screenshots or short screen recordings for UI changes.

## API Notes

List endpoint, schema, response, error, or authentication changes.

## Deployment Notes

List environment variables, migrations, indexes, or deployment ordering concerns.

## Reviewer Focus

Call out any areas where reviewer attention would be especially useful.
